limits: Receipt-derived selectors and inputs are development exposed.

Five repetitions measure execution stability, not five independent datasets.
Dynamic crAPI/AIGoat and safe runtime-property probes need separate reset bindings.

New static host processes use private network namespaces; old host scans did not all do so.
Trivy vulnerability profiles use the qualified read-only database/in-memory cache mode; no private database copy is timed.
Pinned images are unchanged inputs; no image rebuild time is included in detector timings.
